title: Overdrive live coach: the answer to a start
description: The answer to POST /v1/live/sessions (201, spec §12.1, ADR 0038). coach.on says whether the live coach will speak in this ride. When it is on, sessionId names the session (1 to 64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -) and reason is null: the app streams a snapshot every snapshotEverySeconds seconds to POST /v1/live/sessions/{id}/snapshots and listens on GET /v1/live/sessions/{id}/cues. When it is off, sessionId is null, reason says why and the ride is unaffected: feature-off (the owner turned the live coach off), no-tts (no speech service is configured), no-llm (no language model is configured), no-workout (no workoutId, or the service does not have that planned workout: a free ride, or one that has left the plan), no-live-coach (the workout does not ask for the coach) or structure-changed (the workout the app plays is not the one the service has: it was changed in between). A reader must treat a reason it does not know as 'off'. serverTime is the service's clock in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, snapshotEverySeconds is always 5. A start that cannot be answered at all (no network) is the app's own case: no cues, nothing else.
